signals.what: Uniswap v4 ships Permissioned Pools — issuer allowlist enforced onchain via hooks (not frontend gate).
signals.why: Major DEX productizes KYC secondary markets for tokenized assets.

signals.what: Raydium ships Permissioned AMMs same day; Superstate first partner for KYC-gated tokenized equities on Solana.
signals.why: ETH + SOL top DEXs ship the same compliance primitive in parallel — Superstate on both.

signals.what: Hyperliquid adds address-allowlisted markets (CT reporting; week of permissioned venue infrastructure).
signals.why: Third major venue in ~same week enabling issuer-restricted secondary trading onchain.

signals.what: HL week Jul 13–19: RWA perps ~52–54% of venue volume (~$25B), first time RWA > crypto categories; single stocks ~61% of RWA.
signals.why: Demand already flipped before permissioned-pool week — rails catching up to flow.

signals.what: Week ended Jul 24: spot ETH ETFs +$104M vs BTC ETFs +$34M; 2nd straight week ETH out-raised BTC. BlackRock ETHA +$96M while IBIT saw heavy late-week outflows.
signals.why: Institutional marginal dollar rotating ETH over BTC — pairs with ETH/BTC breakout narrative.

signals.what: Senate leaders push CLARITY Act fact sheet; combined draft + ethics language in play, still multi-step before law. Schwab: Clarity odds explained ~4% of BTC daily moves YTD.
signals.why: Policy theater vs price — useful for provocative 'bill as narrative, not catalyst' take.

signals.what: US–Iran Hormuz pause day 2; Brent −~7%; BTC ~$65k; DeFi tokens lead bounce (AAVE/LDO/ONDO); Fed decision Wed with hike odds trimmed.
signals.why: Macro risk-on backdrop — weak alone, strong as timing context for RWA/DeFi posts.

signals.what: PUMP +~12% day, mcap toward ~$800M from ~$570M two weeks ago — speculative bid alongside DeFi bounce.
signals.why: Same week as permissioned RWA rails: casino and compliance narratives running in parallel.

angles.thesis: In one week the largest open DEX venues shipped issuer allowlists for secondary trading — permissionless branding stays, compliant rails become the RWA product.
angles.voiceHook: DeFi didn't get regulated. It productized the velvet rope.
angles.visualHint: 3-panel dated logos (UNI 23 / RAY 23 / HL 27) + one punchline — Abhi shape, your voice

angles.thesis: HL RWA volume already > crypto (Jul 13–19) before UNI/RAY permissioned pools (Jul 23) — infra is chasing flow, not inventing demand.
angles.voiceHook: They didn't build RWA because it's cool. The volume already left crypto-native.
angles.visualHint: simple before/after: HL category mix chart → then two DEX ship dates

angles.thesis: Second straight week institutional wrappers prefer ETH: ETHA absorbs while IBIT bleeds late-week — rotation is in flows, not just CT ratio charts.
angles.voiceHook: The 'ETH season' call is boring. The BlackRock print isn't.
angles.visualHint: week bar: ETH ETF vs BTC ETF inflows + one-line IBIT vs ETHA

angles.thesis: CLARITY fact-sheet week + Schwab saying bill odds explain ~4% of BTC moves — market prices oil/Fed first, bill as narrative second.
angles.voiceHook: Washington dropped a PDF. Oil dropped 7%. Guess which one moved risk.
angles.visualHint: two receipts side by side: fact sheet headline vs Brent −7%

angles.thesis: Same window: permissioned RWA rails ship while PUMP mcap runs — crypto still sells both velvet-rope institutions and casino overlay as 'the future'.
angles.voiceHook: One timeline, two products: KYC pools and a memecoin printer.
angles.visualHint: split collage: permissioned pool graphic vs PUMP chart

days.note: Bootstrap scan. Strongest cluster = permissioned DEX week (UNI+RAY Jul 23, HL allowlist Jul 27) + HL RWA already majority volume prior week. Parallel: ETH ETF > BTC flows; Clarity theater vs oil-driven risk-on; PUMP run as casino counterpoint. Abhi already posted the convergence shape — our angles differentiate via demand-first / velvet-rope / casino-parallel voice.
